paragraphs.english: Students at Lake School helped visitors during a town festival. Their job was to show people the way from the station to the concert field. They prepared a long written guide in English. When they tested it with two visitors, the visitors stopped several times to read it. One said that the sentences were easy but that reading while carrying bags was difficult.
paragraphs.translation: レイク校の生徒は町の祭りで来訪者を案内した。駅から演奏会場まで道を示す仕事だった。英語で長い案内を作ったが、来訪者二人に試すと何度も止まって読んだ。一人は文は簡単でも、荷物を持って読むのは難しいと言った。

paragraphs.english: The students changed their plan. They put blue arrows on boards at each corner. A short guide at the station told visitors to follow the arrows. They chose blue [1] the festival's other signs were red and yellow. The different color helped people recognize the right route quickly. Volunteers checked each board every hour.
paragraphs.translation: 生徒は計画を変え、各角の板に青い矢印を付けた。駅の短い案内は矢印をたどるよう伝えた。祭りの他の標識が赤と黄だったので青を選んだ。色の違いで正しい道をすぐ見分けられた。ボランティアは毎時板を確認した。

paragraphs.english: At the end of the festival, the students counted fewer questions about directions than expected. They did not throw away the written guide. It was still useful for people who wanted details before leaving the station. The arrows and the guide worked together, serving different needs.
paragraphs.translation: 祭りの終わりには、道を尋ねる質問が予想より少なかった。文章の案内は捨てなかった。駅を出る前に詳細を知りたい人にはまだ役立った。矢印と文章は違う需要に応えて補い合った。

paragraphs.english: Hana wanted to cook dinner for her family of four. She found a soup recipe for two people in a library book. At first, she planned to double every number. Before shopping, she showed the plan to her uncle, who enjoyed cooking. He said that this was a good starting point, but some things needed attention. A larger pot could lose water at a different speed, and vegetables did not all have the same size.
paragraphs.translation: ハナは四人家族の夕食を作りたかった。図書館の本で二人分のスープを見つけ、初めは数を全て二倍にするつもりだった。買い物前に料理好きの叔父に見せると、出発点としてはよいが注意も必要と言われた。大きな鍋では水の減り方が違い、野菜の大きさも一定ではなかった。

paragraphs.english: Hana measured the main ingredients, but she added salt [1], tasting the soup after each small amount. She also cut the potatoes into similar pieces so that they would become soft together. While the soup cooked, she wrote short notes beside the recipe rather than changing the original numbers in the book.
paragraphs.translation: ハナは主な材料を量ったが、塩は少しずつ加え、そのたびに味見した。ジャガイモも同じくらいに切り、同時に柔らかくなるようにした。調理中は本の元の数値を直さず、レシピの横に短いメモを書いた。

paragraphs.english: Dinner was ready a little later than planned. Everyone enjoyed it, and Hana saved her notes for the next time. She learned that a recipe can guide a cook without making every decision for them.
paragraphs.translation: 夕食は予定より少し遅れてできた。皆が楽しみ、ハナは次回用にメモを残した。レシピは案内になるが、料理する人の判断を全て代行するわけではないと学んだ。

paragraphs.english: On her way home, Emi found a small dog beside a closed shop. It had a red collar but no name card. Emi did not try to take it home. paragraphs.translation: 帰宅途中、エミは閉店した店の横で小犬を見つけた。赤い首輪はあるが名札はなかった。家に連れて帰ろうとせず、父に電話して一緒に店の近くで待った。近くの作業員に犬を探す人がいないか尋ねたが、何も聞いていなかったので町の動物担当窓口に連絡した。

paragraphs.english: An officer arrived and checked the dog's collar. Inside it was a small card with a telephone number. The card was [1] from the outside, which explained why Emi had missed it. paragraphs.english: Daichi joined the school radio team because he liked talking. His first job was to announce the rules for a music competition. He practiced reading the message as fast as the older members. During the real announcement, he finished early and felt proud. Later, however, several students came to the radio room to ask when they had to send in their names. They had not caught the date.
paragraphs.translation: ダイチは話すのが好きで放送部に入った。初仕事は音楽大会の規則の案内だった。上級生並みに速く読む練習をし、本番は早く終えて誇らしかった。ところが後で、生徒が何人も名前の提出期限を尋ねに来た。日付を聞き取れなかったのだ。

paragraphs.english: A senior member listened to the recording with him. She said that speed was less important than speaking [1]. Daichi added short pauses before dates and place names. He asked a friend to listen without looking at the written message. This time, the friend could repeat all the important details correctly.
paragraphs.translation: 上級生と録音を聞くと、速さより明瞭に話すことが重要だと言われた。日付や場所の名の前に短い間を入れた。原稿を見ず聞くよう友人に頼むと、今度は重要な詳細を全て正しく言い直せた。

paragraphs.english: For his next announcement, Daichi spoke more slowly. He still sounded lively, but he gave listeners time to understand. paragraphs.english: A town gave new residents a map of bicycle routes. The map showed the shortest way between the station and the swimming pool. Yuto followed it on his first visit. paragraphs.translation: 町は新しい住民に自転車道の地図を配った。駅とプール間の最短経路が示され、ユウトは初訪問でたどった。短いが急坂で自転車を押す必要があった。プールで別の道を来た女子に会った。距離は長いが楽だという。

paragraphs.english: Yuto tried her route the next weekend. It followed a river and had almost no hills. He reached the pool feeling less tired. He realized that the [1] route was not always the most comfortable one. Distance was only one thing that mattered when choosing a road.
paragraphs.translation: 翌週末にその道を試すと、川沿いで坂がほとんどなかった。前より疲れず着き、最短が常に最も快適とは限らないと気づいた。道を選ぶ時、距離は大切な要素の一つにすぎなかった。

paragraphs.english: He sent the town office a suggestion. Instead of showing only one route, the map could mark hills and offer a flatter choice. paragraphs.english: The students in Class Two decided to make a monthly newspaper. At the first meeting, nearly everyone wanted to write about the school's best football player. Their teacher asked whether the newspaper should tell readers only things they already knew. The class made a list of people whose work was useful but not often discussed. It included a cook, a library helper, and a student who watered the classroom plants.
paragraphs.translation: 二組は月刊新聞を作ることにした。初会議ではほぼ全員が学校一のサッカー選手を扱いたがった。先生は既知の話だけを伝えるべきかと尋ねた。クラスは役立つのにあまり話題にならない人を挙げ、調理員、図書係、教室の植物に水をやる生徒を入れた。

paragraphs.english: They chose the cook for their first interview. She explained how she planned meals for hundreds of students while avoiding waste. paragraphs.translation: 初回は調理員に取材し、大勢の生徒の食事を無駄を避けながら計画する話を聞いた。記者は注意深く質問し、正確な答えを記録した。印刷前には、仕事を正しく理解したか確認するため記事を本人に見せた。

paragraphs.english: A community garden used a long hose to water its plants. During a dry summer, the gardeners wanted to use less drinking water. One member suggested collecting rain from the roof of their small storehouse. They placed a tank under a pipe and waited for the next rainy day. The tank filled quickly, and everyone was pleased until they noticed leaves floating on the surface.
paragraphs.translation: 共同菜園では長いホースで水やりをしていた。乾燥した夏、飲料水の使用を減らそうと、物置の屋根の雨を集める案が出た。管の下にタンクを置いて雨を待つとすぐ満ちたが、水面に葉が浮いていることに気づいた。

paragraphs.english: The group covered the opening with a strong net. Water could pass through it, [1] most leaves stayed outside. They also put a clear label on the tank. The collected water was for the garden, not for drinking. Children could help water the plants, but an adult always checked the tank first.
paragraphs.translation: 一同は口を丈夫な網で覆った。水は通るが大半の葉は入らなかった。分かりやすいラベルも付けた。集めた水は菜園用で、飲料用ではない。子供も水やりを手伝えるが、大人が必ず先にタンクを確認した。

paragraphs.english: By the end of the summer, the gardeners were using the hose less often. They had not stopped needing water, and the tank was sometimes empty. Still, it gave them another source when rain had fallen. They planned to keep a simple record of rainy days and water use the following year.
paragraphs.translation: 夏の終わりにはホースを使う回数が減った。水が不要になったわけではなく、タンクが空の時もあった。それでも雨の後は別の水源になった。翌年は雨の日と使用量の簡単な記録を残す計画を立てた。

paragraphs.english: The film club planned to show a short movie at a school event. Some scenes depended on quiet conversation, but the hall was close to a busy street. During practice, passing buses made the words difficult to hear. The members first thought about turning the speakers up. Their teacher suggested another way: adding written lines at the bottom of the screen.
paragraphs.translation: 映画部は学校行事で短編を上映する計画だった。静かな会話が重要な場面もあったが、会場は交通量の多い通りの近くだった。練習ではバスの音で言葉が聞こえにくかった。最初は音量を上げようとしたが、先生は画面下に文字を付ける別案を出した。

paragraphs.english: The club added subtitles and checked them carefully. The words had to remain on screen long enough to read. They also had to match what the characters were saying. This took more time than expected. [1], the club finished the work before the event and invited students to watch from the back of the hall.
paragraphs.translation: 部は字幕を付けて丁寧に確認した。読める時間だけ画面に残し、登場人物の発言にも合わせる必要があった。予想より時間がかかったが、行事前には完成し、会場の後ろから見るよう生徒を招いた。

paragraphs.english: The viewers could follow the story even when a bus passed outside. One student said that the subtitles also helped her understand an unfamiliar word. The club decided to keep them in future films. A change made for one problem had turned out to be useful in several ways.
paragraphs.translation: 外をバスが通っても観客は筋を追えた。字幕で知らない語も分かったという生徒がいた。部は今後も字幕を残すことにした。一つの問題への変更が、複数の点で役立ったのだ。
